newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY BCE MAIZE FUTURES MIXED, WHEAT TRENDLESS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY BCE MAIZE FUTURES MIXED, WHEAT TRENDLESS.

text.p: Maize futures prices on the grain section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange ended mixed but with some surprises while wheat prices remained trendless, traders said.
"Maize for the July delivery is cheaper than either May or March," said Ferenc Kiss of Agrokont.
He explained this by expectations of narrowing export outlooks for the country's maize surplus.
"Exports possibilities to the Czech Republic and Poland will run out by the end of May," he said.
July delivery maize futures ended at 18,800 forints, for May at 19,000 forints and for March at 19,250.
The wheat futures market remained trendless as expectations regarding the 1997 crop can only be confirmed once the snow has melted, he said.
Accordingly, only small batches changed hands on Tuesday.
Tuesday's total turnover was 249.2 million forints or 537 contracts, of which 300 contracts were for maize.
Lot size is 20,000 kgs for all contracts.
